vision: Enable operations teams to receive real-time incident notifications with automated SLA countdowns, ensuring rapid response, improved resolution times, and compliance with service-level agreements.
scope: The epic covers real-time detection and dissemination of incident alerts, integration with SLA timers, and notification routing via multiple channels (e.g., email, mobile, chat). It excludes historical reporting and dashboard analytics.
success_criteria: Incidents are notified to designated ops members within 30 seconds of occurrence.
SLA countdown timers are visible and accurately reflect resolution targets.

user_stories.title: Receive real-time notifications for new incidents
user_stories.i_want: to receive immediate alerts when an incident is detected
user_stories.so_that: I can respond quickly and reduce resolution times

acceptance_criteria.given: an active monitoring system detects an incident
acceptance_criteria.then: the ops team receives a real-time notification within 30 seconds

user_stories.title: View and track SLA countdown timer for each incident
user_stories.i_want: to see a real-time SLA timer linked to each incident
user_stories.so_that: I can prioritize issues approaching deadline and ensure SLA compliance

acceptance_criteria.given: an incident with an associated SLA target
acceptance_criteria.then: the remaining SLA time is displayed and updates in real-time until resolution

user_stories.title: Receive escalations when SLA thresholds are breached
user_stories.i_want: to get automated escalation alerts when an incident nears or exceeds its SLA limit
user_stories.so_that: I can reallocate resources and prevent SLA violations

acceptance_criteria.given: an incident approaching its SLA deadline
acceptance_criteria.when: the remaining time crosses a predefined threshold
acceptance_criteria.then: a notification is sent to the ops lead for escalation action
